args: Identify the retained cream-cheese carton and its SAME printed broad face. Request p0,p1,p2,p3 as distributed depth-valid interior face samples, away from seams and fingers; these are not texture correspondences. Independently identify the two physical Cream-initial-C short-end corners c0,c1, in the saved physical order, and return their current end_pixels and camera. No opposite hidden corners are required. For bowl stationarity, request b0 and/or b1 at the saved physical medallion identities, not a similar repeated motif. If those are occluded, switch to rim_samples and request v0,v1,v2 at well-separated actual INNER top-lip points. Assess the local CLOSED-finger remaining tilt and elevated route to above the bowl from the actual pose, considering the bottle and visible surroundings. The remaining tilt may use the saved target or extend it by at most 0.18 rad about the same physical short edge, but total remaining rotation is bounded by 0.45 rad and TCP drift by 8 mm. Assess this bounded local extension too; numerical fit and sweep checks will select a candidate before action. Do not require release clearance yet. Unknown is allowed. Use English ASCII. Historical projections are not current detections.

bowl_mark_ids: b0: center of the large pale radial flower/star medallion on the visible interior floor.
b1: center of the separate smaller pale floral rosette on the bottle-side rear inner wall, above and beside the floor medallion.

end_identity_reference.scope: Physical identity reference only; after movement these pixels are not current measurements.

result.explanation: The current wrist image shows the same blue Cream/Fresh broad face between the fingers. Its visible Cream-initial-C short-end corners are c0 on the left and c1 on the right, in the saved physical order. Appearance is consistent with retention; closure alone does not prove it. Use the fresh samples for the attachment check. No external obstruction is visible for the bounded remaining closed-finger tilt and elevated approach from the bowl's right side, including the proposed extension. The bottle is behind and left of the bowl, not visibly across this approach. Clear applies only to this local scope: remaining rotation at most 0.45 rad, extension at most 0.18 rad about the same physical short edge, and TCP drift at most 8 mm from the actual frame-306 pose. The old saved TCP is about 18 mm away and is outside that drift allowance. Numerical fit and sweep checks must select the candidate using fresh geometry. Robot self-occlusion hides the opposite carton end and some nearby space; it is not an observed external obstruction. Hidden contacts, future slip, whole-arm clearance and release clearance are not established. Earlier actual images are unavailable here; supplied earlier attachment tests are historical evidence, not an independent image comparison.

parameters.notes: Fresh frame-306 selections, not historical projections. p0-p3 sample the same printed face interior, away from seams and fingers; they are not texture correspondences. c0/c1 mark visible physical corners; validate boundary depth, especially c1 after its earlier depth failure. b0 is the large floor medallion center; b1 is the smaller bottle-side rear inner-wall rosette, not another repeated motif. The bowl appears same, upright and unchanged; returned landmarks permit metric stationarity revalidation. Regions include silhouettes and background and require segmentation. Table samples measure surfaces, not free space. Opposite carton corners are self-occluded and are not inferred. Placement and release are not established.
